content:
**Skyline Valley** is one of the eight regions of Appalachia.

Occupying the southernmost area of the map, Skyline Valley is home to Shenandoah National Park and well as the main entrance to Vault 63 and the associated Bavaria, Rhineland and Saxony research sites. Most of the valley is blanketed by The Storm - an ongoing artificial electrical storm vortex that blots out the sun and emits lightning strikes that can stagger players.

Skyline Valley also used to be home to Milepost Zero, a base of operations and waypoint for Blue Ridge caravans entering Appalachia from the south.

Skyline Valley appears in *Fallout 76*.
